SI-4_title.answer: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

NM2-1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used a multimodal variational autoencoder (mmVAE) for normative modeling. The mmVAE had separate modality-specific encoders and decoders for individual modalities (MRI, amyloid PET, tau PET). It uses a Product-of-Experts (POE) approach to combine the latent space parameters of individual modalities into a shared latent space. The model was conditioned on age and sex. The encoder and decoder networks consisted of four fully connected layers (512, 256, 128, 64 for encoder; 64, 128, 256, 512 for decoder) with a latent dimension of 64. Training used Adam optimizer with 500 epochs, learning rate 10^-5, and batch size 256.
NM2-1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: In this study, we used a previously validated deep learning-based normative modeling framework. This framework is based on a multimodal variational autoencoder (mmVAE), which takes as input cross-sectional ATN biomarker data including regional gray matter volumes, as well as amyloid FBP and tau FTP SUVR values

NM2-2_response_variable.detail: Three modalities were used as response variables: (1) Regional gray matter volumes from T1-weighted MRI - 66 cortical ROIs (33 per hemisphere) and 24 subcortical ROIs, normalized by intracranial volume (ICV); (2) Amyloid PET SUVR values using [18F]-Florbetapir (FBP) - 66 cortical and 24 subcortical ROIs, normalized relative to whole cerebellum reference region; (3) Tau PET SUVR values using [18F]-Flortaucipir (FTP) - 66 cortical and 24 subcortical ROIs, normalized relative to inferior cerebellar gray matter reference region. Total of 270 regional features (90 ROIs x 3 modalities).
NM2-2_response_variable.supporting_text: The final data included in our analyses (both ADNI and Knight ADRC) included pre-processed regional grey matter volumes of 66 cortical ROIs (33 per hemisphere) and 24 subcortical ROIs for each participant. All ROI volumes were normalized by the intracranial volume (ICV). ... the final amyloid-FBP and tau-FTP data included in our analyses from both ADNI and Knight ADRC consisted of regional standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) values for 66 cortical ROIs (33 per hemisphere) and 24 subcortical ROIs for each participant.

NM2-3_explanatory_variables.detail: The mmVAE model was conditioned on age and sex as covariates. Age was transformed into a one-hot encoding vector with 44 positions (corresponding to years within the range of 47-91 years). Sex was represented as a one-hot encoded vector with two positions (male/female). Both vectors were used together with the latent code by the modality-specific decoders to reconstruct the brain data.
NM2-3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: mmVAE was conditioned on the age and sex of participants to remove the effect of covariates (see Supplementary Methods SM4.3). ... We conditioned our proposed mmVAE on the age and sex of patients, to ensure that the deviations in regional brain volumes reflect only disease pathology and not deviations due to effects of covariates.
